Materials:
- Use paper or cardstock in colors/textures different from real currency 
- Avoid exact sizing, paper quality, or security features of official money
- Include prominent "EDUCATIONAL USE ONLY" or similar text

Design:
- Draw inspiration from historical artistic styles and cultural imagery
- Avoid direct copying of national seals, portraits, or other identifying elements
- Use unique size, shape, or design elements that make it unmistakably a model

Production:
- Avoid mass production techniques used for official currency
- Print or hand-produce each model individually 
- Number or mark models clearly as "NOT LEGAL TENDER"

Distribution:
- Only provide models to accredited educational institutions and researchers
- Maintain records of all models distributed
